risks.title: Intense competition from QSR and delivery
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked at the top after macro factors, described as 'intense' with direct impact on growth and results. Strong language ('harder to expand', 'revenues could decline'). Competition category highly weighted in the restaurant sector.

risks.title: Dependence on consumer preferences
risks.score_rationale: First risk mentioned, tied to demand, with reference to major external factors (inflation, health trends, mobile app). Language repeated and reinforced ('adversely affect', 'shift in spending').

risks.title: Commodity shortages or rising input costs
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of arabica coffee, dairy, packaging, construction. Direct impact on margins. Specific language on recent inflation. Less existential than competition but critical for profitability.

risks.title: Equipment supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Specifically cited for coffee machines and equipment. Interruption would prevent production. Less frequent but high impact. Industrial category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on culture and talent
risks.score_rationale: Risk of declining engagement as the company grows, difficulty in recruiting. Emphasis on the importance of culture. Impact on service quality. Preventive but recurring language.

risks.title: Risky geographic expansion
risks.score_rationale: Concentration in the Western United States, regional risks (weather, local regulations). Mention of drive-thru restrictions. Less global but significant for growth.

risks.title: Dependence on franchise partners
risks.score_rationale: 325 franchisees, growth strategy tied to their success. Operational control limitations, potential conflicts of interest. Cautious language ('limited control', 'could harm').

ai_positioning.summary: BROS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
